items.title: September 2026 Major Product Update – What’s New
items.category: CAD・CAE・設計自動化
items.excerpt: Fusion’s September update makes Autodesk Assistant generally available, adds natural-language bulk component-property edits and custom-property administration, expands simulation and process-simulation APIs, and introduces deterministic loft mapping plus a mesh-assisted Boolean fallback.
items.query: site:autodesk.com September 2026 AI generative design Fusion engineering

items.title: Achieving Single-Sign-On Agentic access to SAP with AWS for SAP MCP Server
items.category: AIエージェント・MCP・企業システム
items.excerpt: AWS shows full identity propagation from an AI agent through Entra ID to SAP so SAP maps each request to the named user rather than a shared service account. The design preserves existing SAP authorization and audit semantics while avoiding static shared SAP credentials.
items.query: site:aws.amazon.com September 9 2026 SAP MCP identity propagation

items.title: Model-agnostic PII detection with LLMs
items.category: AI安全性・データ
items.excerpt: AWS describes a configurable instruction-driven PII detector that can run on Bedrock-managed LLMs. It was evaluated on five public PII corpora across nine LLM-based detectors, targeting flexible entity schemas and multilingual free text without retraining a fixed token-classification model.
items.query: site:aws.amazon.com/blogs September 10 2026 PII LLM detector

items.title: How AvioBook builds turnaround insights from operational data with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.category: 航空・企業AI・AIエージェント
items.excerpt: AvioBook, a Thales Group company, prototyped Connected Analytics on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to turn airline operational data into evidence-based natural-language answers about turnaround delays. The post frames gate-delay economics as a business case; those dollar figures are illustrative vendor estimates.
items.query: site:aws.amazon.com September 10 2026 AvioBook AgentCore turnaround
items.organization: AvioBook / Thales Group / Amazon Web Services

items.title: More Ways to Run Payroll and Stay Ahead of Compliance, Now in the Gusto Plugin for ChatGPT
items.category: 企業AI・AI-native SaaS
items.excerpt: Gusto expanded its ChatGPT plugin from Q&A and simple payroll toward preparing complex payroll, applying bonuses or tips, fixing timesheets, moving labor-cost data into budgets, and proactive compliance work. High-impact payroll actions remain approval-oriented rather than silent execution.
items.query: site:gusto.com/company-news September 8 2026 ChatGPT plugin payroll

items.title: Stripe helps Muse, Meta’s new personal AI agent, shop across the internet with Link
items.category: AIエージェント・決済インフラ
items.excerpt: Meta integrated Link’s wallet for agents with Muse. Stripe says Muse can check out at more than one million Link merchants using a stored payment method; elsewhere Link issues a single-use virtual card scoped to the approved purchase, making transaction scope an explicit agent-control primitive.
items.query: site:stripe.com September 8 2026 Muse Link agent shopping

items.title: Tata Elxsi Invests in KAVIA AI to Scale AI-Driven Software Engineering for Products and Enterprises
items.category: AIエージェント・コーディング・企業AI
items.excerpt: Tata Elxsi invested in KAVIA AI and is expanding joint enterprise engineering use. The stated AIDLC scope spans architecture, brownfield refactoring, development, QA, deployment, monitoring and debugging; KAVIA adds a knowledge graph and governed artifacts across complex codebases.
items.query: KAVIA AI Tata Elxsi September 10 2026 AI software engineering

items.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash：更强、更快、更普惠
items.category: 最新AIモデル・オープンウェイト
items.excerpt: DeepSeek released V4.1 Flash, a 552B-parameter MoE with a Causal-Encoder-Decoder architecture and asymmetric activation of 8B parameters for input and 16B for output. The model has native multimodal vision and open weights; benchmark superiority claims are vendor-reported.
items.query: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash official September 10 2026

items.title: Introducing OUI-1: world's first model for Generative UI
items.category: オープンウェイト・AI-native UI
items.excerpt: OUI-1 is a DiffusionGemma finetune for generating OpenUI Lang interfaces, with 26B total and 4B active parameters and weights under Gemma terms. Thesys reports 71.7% on its Generative UI Benchmark versus 13.0% for the base model; the parser provides a verifiable structural reward.
items.query: Introducing OUI-1 OpenUI Thesys September 8 2026

items.title: Granite TimeSeries PatchTST-FM-r2
items.category: オープンモデル・時系列・Industrial AI
items.excerpt: IBM’s ~385M-parameter zero-shot time-series model replaces plain Transformer blocks with Conformer blocks, uses an 8192-step context and 99-quantile head, and is dual-licensed under Apache 2.0 or OpenMDW 1.0. IBM reports #2 among replicable zero-shot models on GIFT-Eval as of Aug. 31.
items.query: Granite TimeSeries PatchTST-FM-r2 IBM open model September 2026

items.title: IBM and NASA Release Open-Source AI Model to Support Lunar Exploration
items.category: Scientific AI・地球宇宙科学
items.excerpt: IBM and NASA released the open-source NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model, trained on more than 30 data layers from nine instruments across four NASA missions. The organizations report up to 23% better accuracy than widely used methods for identifying lunar features including ice, craters and volcanic formations.
items.query: Lunar Foundation Model IBM NASA September 10 2026

items.title: OpenEarthAgent: A Unified Framework for Tool-Augmented Geospatial Agents
items.category: Scientific AI・AIエージェント・地理空間
items.excerpt: OpenEarthAgent trains tool-augmented geospatial agents over satellite imagery and explicit reasoning traces. The corpus contains 14,538 training and 1,169 evaluation instances, over 100K training reasoning steps and over 7K evaluation steps, spanning GIS operations and multispectral indices.
items.query: OpenEarthAgent IBM Research September 8 2026

items.title: World's First: Kyocera and Tohoku University Develop Technology to Integrate Optical Isolators Directly onto Silicon Photonics Chips
items.category: HPC/GPU・AIインフラ・フォトニクス
items.excerpt: Kyocera and Tohoku University used localized laser annealing to integrate a magneto-optical isolator directly on silicon photonics without heating the full chip. They report 13.6 dB isolation, reducing back-reflected light by about 95%; the related IEEE Access paper was published Sept. 2.
items.query: integrated optical isolator Kyocera September 10 2026 silicon photonics

items.title: 「第5回 スマート工場EXPO」にて「TRENG Factory AI」を紹介
items.source: 東レエンジニアリング
items.category: Industrial AI・製造
items.excerpt: Toray Engineering is presenting TRENG Factory AI, combining image analysis, equipment control and process-data models for identification, execution and prediction. The company says it is extending AI used in semiconductor inspection and battery-coating equipment toward plant-wide automation and optimization.
items.query: 東レエンジニアリング TRENG Factory AI 2026 9月
items.organization: 東レエンジニアリング
items.company: 東レエンジニアリング

items.title: Nokia launches AI and edge platform for resilient field operations
items.category: Industrial AI・Edge AI・デジタルツイン
items.excerpt: Nokia launched Cognitive Operations, combining mission-critical communications, GPU-accelerated edge compute and operational AI. Initial applications include mining, public safety and defense, with AI assistance, live 3D digital twins, video analytics, predictive maintenance and autonomous safety monitoring.
items.query: Nokia Cognitive Operations September 10 2026 digital twin AI

items.title: Reasoning-Driven Design of Single-Atom Catalysts via a Multiagent Large Language Model Framework
items.category: Scientific AI・材料・触媒設計
items.excerpt: MAESTRO uses specialized LLM agents plus an ML force-field surrogate in an iterative catalyst design loop. The paper reports discovery of ORR single-atom catalysts that break conventional intermediate scaling relations; DFT checks confirmed six selected candidates below the 0.36 V scaling-based limit.
items.query: Reasoning-Driven Design Single-Atom Catalysts MAESTRO September 2026

items.title: A Requirements-Driven Lifecycle Digital Twin Methodology for Innovative SMRs: Architecture Integration and Expected Benefits
items.category: デジタルツイン・MBSE・設計検証
items.excerpt: The methodology integrates requirements management, system architecture, physics-based simulation and live operational data from early design through construction, commissioning, operation and maintenance for innovative SMRs. It targets design V&V, licensing risk reduction and predictive operations.
items.query: requirements-driven lifecycle digital twin ENBIS 2026 SMR
items.organization: Innovative Small Modular Reactor Development Agency

items.title: Development of digital twins in metrology for a stereovision system
items.category: デジタルツイン・計測・製造
items.excerpt: This work proposes a closed-loop digital twin for stereovision metrology that automates calibration and chooses measurement strategy using environmental factors and estimated uncertainty. The design links physical and digital domains while preserving traceability to the meter definition.
items.query: digital twin metrology stereovision ENBIS September 2026

items.title: AI Physics X Agentic AI — チップ設計から製造プロセス制御までの技術スタック解説
items.category: EDA・AI Physics・AIエージェント
items.excerpt: NVIDIA’s DVCon Japan keynote covers cuDSS, cuLitho, AI physics for TCAD, PhysicsNeMo and Nemotron-based agentic AI across semiconductor design, lithography, process control, inspection and testing. It is a conference technology-stack presentation, not a new product-release claim.
items.query: DVCon Japan 2026 AI Physics Agentic AI NVIDIA

items.title: ESD Alliance Webinar: Gen-AI for Chip Design and Security
items.category: EDA・AIエージェント・設計検証
items.excerpt: SEMI’s ESD Alliance session presents a multi-agent intelligent-assistant architecture intended to automate and augment SoC design and security verification. The topic is relevant to agentic EDA because it couples functional design, formal/security verification and multi-agent orchestration.
items.query: SEMI Gen-AI chip design security multi-agent September 10 2026

items.title: Automation and Autonomous Experimentation in Organic Synthesis Using Chemspeed and Information Science
items.category: Scientific AI・研究自動化・化学
items.excerpt: NIMS researcher Yuuya Nagata presents a workflow combining a Chemspeed synthesis platform with Bayesian optimization for autonomous organic synthesis, plus translation of literature procedures into machine-executable workflows. It is a current technical presentation rather than a paper release.
items.query: autonomous experimentation organic synthesis NIMS Chemspeed September 10 2026

items.title: Simcenter Realize Club: Bucharest — AI in Engineering and simulation
items.category: AIによる設計・CAE
items.excerpt: Siemens’ event program centers on Engineering AI for fast prediction and includes Simcenter PhysicsAI for battery design plus customer applications. It is retained as a current implementation/roadmap signal; it should not be read as an independent performance validation or a new product launch.
items.query: Siemens Simcenter PhysicsAI battery design September 10 2026

items.title: Gartner Survey Finds Only 22% of Organizations Have Successfully Scaled AI Across Multiple Business Units
items.category: 企業AI・ROI・調査
items.excerpt: Gartner surveyed 1,303 respondents at organizations with at least $50M annual revenue. It reports 22% have scaled AI across multiple business units or adopted an AI-first approach, 85% of functional leaders plan higher 2026 AI spending, and high performers report positive returns on 81% of AI initiatives.
items.query: September 2026 AI adoption survey enterprise ROI report

items.title: Stuck in Agentic AI Pilot Purgatory? UiPath Survey Points to Orchestration as Key to Scaling Enterprise Deployments
items.category: 企業AI・Agentic AI・調査
items.excerpt: UiPath surveyed 590 C-suite and IT practitioners at $1B+ companies in six markets. Only 31% report AI fully embedded; leading barriers include data readiness (38%), workflow/system integration (37%) and governance (33%). Among firms with fully embedded orchestration, 89% report meeting or beating ROI expectations.
items.query: UiPath AI Adoption Orchestration Survey 2026 September 9

items.title: Small Businesses That Adopted AI Are Hiring Faster, New Gusto Research Finds
items.category: 企業AI・Workforce・調査
items.excerpt: Gusto linked a prior AI-adoption survey to real payroll data, comparing 1,593 AI adopters with 669 AI-aware non-adopters over the following year. It reports adopters grew headcount about 7% more, with the gap near 10% for firms under 10 employees; the design is observational rather than randomized.
items.query: Small Businesses That Adopted AI Are Hiring Faster Gusto September 10 2026

items.title: Canadian Businesses Race to Adopt Agentic AI, but 97% Say They Aren't Fully Ready
items.category: 企業AI・Agentic AI・調査
items.excerpt: Oxford Economics surveyed 2,600 business leaders in 13 countries for SAP, including 200 in Canada. In Canada, 66% report piloting agentic AI while 97% say they are not fully ready; reported issues include integration effort, reliability, incorrect agent actions, inconsistent outcomes and weak governance.
items.query: SAP Oxford Economics agentic AI readiness Canada September 10 2026

items.title: New Visa Research Finds Consumer Trust is Accelerating the Path to Agentic Commerce
items.category: AIエージェント・Agentic Commerce・調査
items.excerpt: Visa’s Trust Index reports 23% of U.S. consumers trust generative AI to handle payment transactions on their behalf, while 61% say they would trust Visa for agentic transactions. The result is vendor-sponsored consumer research and should be treated as a trust/adoption signal rather than neutral market measurement.
items.query: Visa Trust Index agentic commerce September 9 2026
